status: closed: bounded sample census found no authentic MSVBVM60 DriveListBox executable; no product change
question: Whether the existing VB5 DriveListBox rendering path can safely be enabled for VB6.
method: Read-only review of the previously pinned Code Architects source identity, its exact executable/import identity, the fixed 28-form VB6 review, and the fixed 214-archive VB6 catalogue. No IDE, OCX registration, download, arbitrary binary execution, desktop interaction, injection, or user process was used.

positive_source_match.disposition: The directory name and source language are not runtime identity. This is an authentic VB5 executable and remains evidence only for the already-delivered VB5 path.

decision: Do not add a ThunderRT6DriveListBox alias or alter the renderer. A guessed runtime60 class would violate the exact-owner rule and could make a different owner-draw/popup/image protocol look supported. The absence of a display/UAC session is irrelevant to this source and PE identity conclusion and was not treated as a blocker.
remaining: An independently licensed/authentic x86 MSVBVM60 executable containing a normal DriveListBox is required before any runtime60 implementation S. VB5 remains supported as recorded in vb-file-controls.json.
